answer: I would anchor trust in Verifiable credential from a national digital ID wallet. With a credential issued by the national ID wallet and revocable only by the state, a single kernel check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the nebula compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the reef of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
